note: Adapted from Chhotani's (1997) species description; the original is in English, and the alate and worker were added from specimens collected in Kerala; the maximum diameter of the fontanelle plate is not given because of damaged OCR; distribution records, synonymic citations and figure numbers are not included.

sections.label: Diagnostic characters
sections.text: Soldier head capsule nearly rectangular, about 1.58–1.65 times as long as wide, with the anterior lateral corners produced into short pointed tubercles, the mandibles asymmetrical and the left mandible strongly twisted in the middle, and the anterior margin of the pronotum with a distinct notch; alate body length with wings 13.0–13.50 mm, antennae 15-segmented with segment 3 shortest.

sections.label: Soldier
sections.text: Head capsule brownish yellow to pale brown; antennae pale brown; left mandible black, right mandible red-black; legs and body pale yellow. Head sparsely hairy, body more densely hairy. Body length 6.50–7.60 mm. Head capsule nearly rectangular, sides nearly straight or very weakly convex; anterior lateral corners produced into short pointed tubercles; about 1.58–1.65 times as long as wide; in lateral view the frons inclines forwards about 45° and the posterior part is weakly inclined; coronal suture distinct, extending from the posterior margin beyond the middle of the head; length with mandibles 4.00–4.40 mm, head length without mandibles 2.22–2.40 mm, maximum width 1.38–1.55 mm. Fontanelle transverse, situated at the base of the frontal slope; distance from the occiput to the fontanelle 1.92–2.00 mm; fontanelle gland small. Antennae 14-segmented, segments 2, 3 and 4 subequal, sometimes segment 3 slightly longer. Labrum wider than long, asymmetrical, anterior margin broadly concave, anterolateral margins in front of the base of the spine-like process weakly serrate. Mandibles asymmetrical, shorter than the head; left mandible strongly twisted in the middle, with a short pointed apex; right mandible blade-like, weakly incurved at the apex, the apical point short; left mandible 1.88–2.00 mm, right mandible 1.88–1.93 mm. Postmentum club-shaped, the waist narrow and long; length 1.11–1.20 mm, maximum width 0.36–0.45 mm, waist width 0.14–0.18 mm. Pronotum saddle-shaped, anterior margin with a distinct notch; length 0.25–0.31 mm, width 0.70–0.75 mm.

sections.label: Worker
sections.text: Head pale yellow; antennae and legs paler; abdomen translucent. Head rather hairy, body densely hairy. Body length 4.00–4.60 mm. Head nearly circular, wider than long; head length to the tip of the labrum 1.33–1.40 mm, head length without mandibles 0.85–0.95 mm, maximum width 1.08–1.10 mm. Fontanelle plate circular, diameter 0.075–0.10 mm. Antennae 14-segmented, segments 2 and 3 subequal, segment 4 shortest. Postclypeus strongly convex, about half as long as wide; length 0.25–0.26 mm, width 0.50–0.53 mm. Pronotum saddle-shaped, anterior margin weakly notched; length 0.25–0.28 mm, width 0.57–0.60 mm.

sections.label: Alate
sections.text: Head, pronotum and abdominal dorsum brown; antennae and postclypeus yellowish brown; legs and underside of the abdomen pale yellow; wings pale brown. Head and body covered with a layer of fine short hairs together with several long hairs; wing margins hairy, the membrane with a few hairs near the apex. Body length with wings 13.0–13.50 mm, body length without wings 7.30–7.60 mm. Head capsule nearly circular, wider than long; length to the tip of the labrum 1.30–1.40 mm, length to the base of the mandibles 0.90–0.95 mm, width including the compound eyes 1.35–1.40 mm. Fontanelle plate large, oval, ocellus-like, minimum diameter 0.10 mm; head dorsum not depressed around the fontanelle. Antennae 15-segmented, segment 3 shortest, segment 4 shorter than segment 2; in one slightly immature specimen the antennae are 14-segmented, segment 3 longer than segment 2 and in the process of dividing. Compound eyes nearly circular, maximum diameter 0.35–0.37 mm, minimum diameter 0.32–0.35 mm. Ocelli broadly oval, separated from the compound eye and from the antennae by about their short diameter. Postclypeus convex and hairy, about half as long as wide or slightly shorter. Pronotum semicircular, the middle of the anterior margin projecting forwards with a shallow notch; the middle of the posterior margin more distinctly incurved; sides nearly straight to weakly convex. Wing membrane densely covered with microsetae.
